ratios.quote: Financial covenants under the 2024 Credit and Note Payable Agreements require the Company to maintain a minimum interest coverage ratio of at least 3.0 :1.0 at the end of each fiscal quarter.

ratios.covenant_name: Leverage Ratio (Funded Indebtedness to Consolidated EBITDA)
ratios.quote: In addition, the Company’s Leverage Ratio at the end of any fiscal quarter shall not be greater than 4.25 :1.0 through December 31, 2024 or greater than 3.75 to 1.0 as of the end of any fiscal quarter thereafter; provided that the Company may elect to temporarily increase the Leverage Ratio by 0.5 :1.0 following a material acquisition under the 2024 Credit and Note Payable Agreements.

parsed.notes: The filing gives no actual ratio values. It states only the requirements and that the Company was in compliance with all covenants as of September 30, 2026. The 3.75x leverage limit applies to quarters from December 31, 2025 onward, per the October 2024 amendments, and can be raised by 0.5x after a material acquisition; the excerpt does not say whether that election is in effect. The leverage ratio also sets the interest margin and commitment fee, but it is listed here because it is a stated financial covenant.
